name: web-webcore-page-footer-with-receipt-card-barcode-and-bracket-wordmark
title: Webcore Footer with Barcode and Bracket Wordmark
whatItIs: The lower part of the same mobile page: the manifesto points, the pink receipt card and a footer with a bracketed lowercase '[mark it]' wordmark, tiny monospace legal and build lines, a barcode graphic and round outlined social icons.
whatItMeans: A barcode and build number in the footer finish the toy-package joke and give the page a product-label feel.
techniques: Barcode as a decorative footer element
